messages:
alex_w: Heads up — planning a midday maintenance Wed 03/25 16:00 UTC for az3. NIC microcode swap + soft reboot across 8 nodes in gpu-pool-saturn. Will cordon+drain, expect ~30-45m for the cohort. Need ops/ML ack and CS heads notified.

maria_s: Acked. Can you post exact node list and drain order? also bumping traffic shift to us-east for the window?

alex_w: Node list will be posted shortly. Plan: drain 2 nodes at a time (staggered), wait kv-cache warmup, validate tail latencies before next pair. We want to avoid cross-region reroute unless we see >5% latency increase.

chen_li: If we do cross-region, egress costs jump. Rough estimate: moving ~20 qps sustained to us-east for 45m ~ 0.03 TB -> ~$2. I'll run a tighter cost delta later.

sam_t: How much spare GPU capacity do we have in us-east to absorb the burst? last forecast said ~120 min of spare at current traffic but depends on burst shape.

jordan_p: We can pre-warm 4 standby nodes in us-east (dedicated pool) as a temporary cushion. That costs ~4 GPU-hours. If priced at $3/GPU-hour that's ~$12. Cheaper than risk of SLA.

alex_w: Good — prefer warmbackfill over hard reroute. We'll only flip routing if we observe >3% error or >200ms p50 bump for 3 consecutive 1-min windows.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: PM-2026-1843. Pager schedule checked: oncall on 03/25 16:00 UTC -> oncall_bob. Auto-assigning runbook.

oncall_bob: I've got the runbook open. I'll be on the channel during the window. Please add the exact kubectl drain commands you plan to run.

alex_w: Drain command example we will use (per node):

```
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
```

will loop with health checks between drains.

maria_s: Post the node hostname pattern so SREs can validate the correct set. Also, add the kv-cache seeding step before uncordon.

alex_w: Node pattern: saturn-az3-gpu-[101..108]. KV seed step (after drain/uncordon) we will run: 

```
python infra/tools/kv_seed.py --pool gpu-pool-saturn --nodes 4 --parallel 2 --minutes 20
```
This primes prefix cache to reduce cold-start tail-latency.

chen_li: Small FYI — the seed script spikes short-lived CPU on those nodes; keep an eye on node-level CPU to avoid OOM with local sidecars.

sam_t: Ops question: do we want to temporarily lower batch sizes on the pool during the window to reduce memory pressure? Could also reduce eviction churn.

jordan_p: Agree. Plan: decrease batch target from 32 -> 16 while nodes are in warmbackfill period (~30m). We revert after 1h. I'll add the route change to the rollout config.

alex_w: Noted. I'll add batch tweak to the maintenance checklist. Also: CS outreach — @maria_s please ping priority customers (2 enterprise teams) pre-window with the ETA and rollback plan.

maria_s: Will do. Draft msg: "Planned maintenance Wed 03/25 16:00 UTC; targeted impact: brief capacity shuffle for az3; we expect no sustained errors; fallback routing ready. Contact CS if you see anything." OK?

chen_li: Quick risk callout — one of the 8 nodes hosts active long-running eval jobs from a research tenant. We should either migrate their pods first or notify them to checkpoint.

alex_w: Good catch. I'll identify those pods and schedule preemptive migration. If migration fails we'll skip that node and pick the next.

infra-bot: Reminder: Canary test after first pair uncordon — run loadscript `tools/load_test/canary_halfqps.sh` and validate p95 < 400ms.

oncall_bob: I'll execute canary and post results. If canary fails, we abort and re-evaluate.

sam_t: Cost summary for the chosen mitigation path (warmbackfill + reduced batching + KV seed): ~4 GPU-hours (us-east warm) + ~0.5 GPU-hours extra from longer jobs during seed ~= ~4.5 GPU-hours -> est $13.5 at $3/GPU-hour. Ops labor ~1.5h. OK from budget?

jordan_p: Approved within maintenance budget. Proceed.

alex_w: Thanks all — final checklist will be posted 1h before window with exact node list and drain order. Please react with :thumbsup: when you have read and are available for 03/25 16:00 UTC.

maria_s: :thumbsup:

chen_li: :thumbsup:

sam_t: :thumbsup:

jordan_p: :thumbsup:

oncall_bob: :thumbsup:
